A shared production source

The story manifest covers 24 chapters, 86 locations and 1,500 exact text records. Its 702 shot plans and 978 independent subtitle clips preserve branch alternatives rather than inventing one combined storyline. Four new scenery interpretations cover the Glass Viaduct, Undercity Well, Chapel of Rain and Archive. The recovered companion pack preserves 18 selected portraits, six backgrounds and 13 earlier variants. Proposed identities and unresolved image defects remain marked.

The main game is unchanged by this review workspace. Its exact dialogue is extracted into the production manifests; the new cinematic staging and art are proposals. All 24 chapters can be inspected, but they do not yet have finished animated movies.
